definitionZh: 边框-左上方-射线CSS属性通过指定定义角曲面的椭圆半径(或半主轴和半小轴半径)来包围一个元素的左上角.
sourceDefinition: The border-top-left-radius CSS property rounds the top-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.
